title: repixel
description: recolors and reshapes items while still maintaining the vanilla feel
body:
a fun project i am currently working on. right now in alpha.
the pack aims to enhance and remake the minecraft items. currently includes the tierd tools and weapons and their respective material

known issues:
the pack shows you currently the "broken or incompatible warning". its completlely fine and shouldnt cause problems its just because i coudnt get the mcmeta file to display the right version.


stand with israel!
